doc: RSI(2) pullback (Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez, Short Term Trading Strategies That Work, TradingMarkets Publishing 2009). Trade with the long-term trend and buy short-term weakness: with the close above the 200-day SMA, buy when the 2-period RSI closes below 10 (the book tests 5 and 10 and deeper); exit when the close is above the 5-day SMA. The mirror short needs the close under the 200-day SMA and RSI(2) above 90. RSI uses Wilder's smoothing. The pane has the 10 and 90 levels; the 5-day SMA is the exit line and the 200-day the trend filter.
